upstream.note: Journal has one event time with a basis; durations stay vendor-reported values in data (see reported-durations)

upstream.reference: REPORT.md §3 row 19 (span times; turn duration != run duration)
upstream.meaning: span times

native_evidence.field: timestamp (RFC 3339 ms) on assistant and user records -> basis 1
no timestamp -> basis 2 (latest preceding reported time, or capture start for 1-3)
timestamp on user, assistant, attachment, queue-operation, api-request, api-request-shape
no timestamp (atis-latch, api-request-blob, last-prompt, cost-state) -> basis 2

concepts.notes: Each contract's time_policy declares reported fields and the fallback; the oracle requires metadata.original_time verbatim with basis 1 when the record reports a time, and absent original_time with basis 2 otherwise (DESIGN §5 'Source-scoped finality and time'). Capture/arrival time (basis 3) is a writer-side observation that the frozen replays cannot ground beyond the declared capture_start.
